projects.name: Aizanoi AI
projects.problem: HR and people teams need quick, accurate help with workforce analytics, KPIs, recruitment, performance management, engagement and day-to-day people questions — without jumping between tools and dashboards.
projects.solution: A chat-based assistant focused on HR analytics and people management. Practical answers with formulas, code examples (SQL, Excel, Power BI, DAX, Python) and clear separation of facts vs. assumptions.
features: Conversational Q&A scoped to HR / People Analytics
Markdown rendering with code block support
Six starter prompts covering KPIs, performance, turnover, dashboard design, Power BI
Local-only data — no file upload, no account, no retention
projects.learned: Prompt design matters more than model choice. A short, clear persona prompt keeps the assistant on-topic while staying flexible enough for both technical and soft HR questions.
